name: Azores Airlines (SATA)
verdict: Owned by the SATA group (SATA Holding), which is controlled by the Regional Government of the Azores. Nothing found.
note: International airline of the Azores-based SATA group (SATA Internacional – Azores Airlines), on the front of Santa Clara's 2026-27 home shirt. Rating note: the Regional Government of the Azores owns SATA Holding and controls the group (EC state-aid press release, 7 June 2022; Reuters via O Jornal/Herald News, 8 Sept 2026), with a privatisation of Azores Airlines (at least 75%) running in 2026 and no buyer confirmed. No record of serious abuses by Portugal or the Azores government is recorded here, and state ownership alone is not a tier.
